title: GAC: Noise-Aware Adaptive Mixing for Hybrid SFT-RL Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2605.26184v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Hybrid post-training combining supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) is the standard paradigm for aligning large language models, yet fixed mixing schedules cannot adapt when the relative noise of the two signals evolves. We derive a noise-aware mixing weight mu* by minimizing an MSE upper bound on the mixed stochastic gradient, yielding a closed-form that balances gradient noise variance and SFT-RL disagreement. Building on the token-wise reweighting of CHORD, the practical Guided Adaptive Controller (GAC) adds EMA smoothing, a schedule prior, and capped updates around this estimator, with all statistics estimated online from existing training tensors. translated_title: GAC：面向混合SFT-RL后训练的噪声感知自适应混合方法
translated_abstract: 结合监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）的混合后训练是对齐大语言模型的标准范式，然而当两种信号的相对噪声发生演变时，固定的混合调度策略无法自适应调整。我们通过最小化混合随机梯度的MSE上界，推导出噪声感知的混合权重 mu*，得到一个平衡梯度噪声方差与SFT-RL分歧的闭式解。在CHORD逐词元重加权的基础上，实用的引导自适应控制器（GAC）在该估计器周围引入了EMA平滑、调度先验和封顶更新，且所有统计量均可从现有训练张量在线估计。仅噪声感知控制器本身在AMC上就比最佳基于规则的控制器高出3.0个百分点；完整系统在数学、代码、科学和逻辑基准上比HPT高出3.8个百分点，同时将KL漂移面积降低了28%。
tldr: 提出噪声感知自适应控制器GAC，通过最小化混合随机梯度MSE上界推导出闭式混合权重，动态平衡SFT与RL信号的梯度噪声和分歧，在多项基准上超越固定混合策略并将KL漂移降低28%。
